why: Both must_catch items are handled. Item 1: the builder brief's current-state section names test/csv.test.js and its existing 'cli' test. Step 2 says "Keep the existing tests as they are", and step 5 requires running `npm test` and confirming it exits 0, which runs test/csv.test.js. Step 5 also has a hand check that the no-flag CSV run (`printf 'a,b\n1,2\n'` → `[{"a":"1","b":"2"}]`) still works. So the CSV path's tests and behaviour have to keep passing. The brief never says outright that parse() is shared with the CSV path, but the item accepts either option. Item 2: verifier Check 6 runs "npm test; echo "exit=$?"" and judges on that. An advisory note says to run test:cli only if package.json defines it, and otherwise to "say so, but judge check 6 on `npm test`".
